title: Audio Dashboard — Example Read-Along
heading: Audio Dashboard — Example
subtitle: Play a card (or tap any word) to READ and LISTEN together — the teleprompter highlights each word in real time from real STT-after-TTS whisper timing.
railLabel: example arc — tap any node to fly there
_note_reference: `reference` is a PLACEHOLDER — replace host-voice/expert-voice with your own registered voice-profile names (see NARRATIONLAYER_PROFILES_FILE) or a direct path to a reference .wav clip. Voice clones are machine-local and are not shipped with the skill. A scene may instead carry `audioWav` (existing WAV) for a daemon-free bring-your-own-audio run.

scenes.title: Q1 · What is this dashboard
scenes.script: So what exactly are we looking at here, and why does the read-along matter?

scenes.title: What is this dashboard — the answer
scenes.script: This is a read-along dashboard. Every word you see is timed to the audio, so clicking a word seeks straight to that moment.
